page.overview:
Who is Anteros?

Anteros (Αντερως) is the god of requited love, literally "love returned", and mutual love. He is the avenger of requited love.

Anteros is usually shown on a scale, held by Aphrodite, with Eros on the opposite side. He also had long hair and huge butterfly wings. He usually has either a golden club or a bow and arrow with lead in the arrows.
